description: Using Multiecuscan diagnostic software, perform a comprehensive multi-system diagnostic scan on a Fiat 500. Scan at least THREE different ECU systems sequentially in simulation mode (choose from the available systems in the software, such as Engine, ABS, Airbag, Dashboard, Body, or others). For each system: navigate to the correct vehicle/module selection, start simulation, read the ECU identification, read all DTCs, then disconnect before moving to the next system. Create a consolidated multi-system diagnostic report at C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\MultiecuscanTasks\multi_system_report.txt that includes: per-system sections with ECU identification, DTCs found with descriptions, and system status assessment. Conclude with an overall vehicle health summary. Cross-reference DTCs with the DTC database provided in the MultiecuscanData folder.
natural_language: Scan at least three ECU systems on a Fiat 500 using Multiecuscan simulation mode. For each system, read ECU info and error codes, then write a consolidated multi-system diagnostic report.
